relations.subject: विश्वेश्वरानन्द
relations.evidence: Svami Vishveshvaranand and Svami Nityanand undertook, jointly, in 1903, the production of a Vedic dictionary... when Svami Nityanand passed away, after short illness, in January, 1914.

relations.subject: विश्वबन्धु
relations.evidence: He carried on till, two years before he passed away, the present writer, in respectful compliance with his desire, took it over for further pursuance as a labour of love, This happened at Lahore during the autumn of 1923.

relations.subject: विश्वबन्धु
relations.evidence: The Vishveshvaranand Institute as a regular office was set up on January 1, 1924.
